findings.current: The people who had gladly taken him along despite his lack of talent and skill had taught him too much.
findings.defect: The Korean says Mujin had seen and learned a great deal from these people; it does not establish that they actively taught him. “Had taught him” adds an implication about their actions.
findings.rationale: 보고 배웠으니까 means he saw and learned from them, not necessarily that they directly taught him. The accepted baseline preserves that distinction.
findings.replacement: He had seen and learned so much from the people who had gladly taken him along despite his lack of talent and skill.

findings.current: He also remembered what the old man had told him when Mujin declared he would become a martial artist.
findings.defect: The assembled passage omits that Mujin had heard the preceding words about war as a child from an old man, and that he remembered them clearly.
findings.rationale: The Korean explicitly identifies the first recollection as words heard in childhood and says Mujin remembered them clearly; the accepted baseline includes this detail.
findings.replacement: Hyuk Mujin clearly remembered those words, which he had heard as a child from an old man. He also remembered what the old man had told him when he declared he would become a martial artist.

findings.current: And with one short sentence, he used all his strength to send Mujin flying far away.
findings.defect: The translation omits that Taishan watched Mujin silently and then gripped him firmly before throwing him.
findings.rationale: The Korean explicitly gives Taishan’s silent gaze and firm grip as actions preceding the throw; the assembled version skips both.
findings.replacement: Taishan watched him in silence, then gripped him tightly. With one short sentence, he used all his strength to send Mujin flying far away.

summary: The translation is largely faithful, but it adds an implication about how Mujin learned from his companions and omits a childhood memory detail and a physical beat before Taishan throws him.
